purpose: Descriptive visualization only; no new inferential endpoint, hypothesis test, clustering, type classification, threshold optimization, or claim expansion.

profile_definition.target_sessions: Exactly the target sessions that are evaluable under the frozen centered-shape audit.
profile_definition.session_profile: For each evaluable target session, reconstruct the identity-matched self predictor used by the frozen common-cell centered-shape estimator: equal-session self conditional P(residual z | cell), restricted to cells jointly supported by self and other predictors for that target, then integrated over the exact self-derived common-cell weights used by the estimator.
profile_definition.individual_profile: Equal-weight mean of that individual's evaluable target-session self profiles across admitted cohorts.
profile_definition.smoothing: Inherited Jeffreys alpha 0.5 inside each session-by-cell conditional profile; no additional smoothing of displayed individual profiles.
profile_definition.row_sum: Each displayed individual profile sums to 1 across the ten frozen centered-height bins.

display_definition.main_figure: One descriptive heatmap figure with one stacked panel per taxon/year panel.
display_definition.columns: The ten frozen centered-height bins in ascending order.
display_definition.rows: One evaluable biological individual per row.
display_definition.row_order: Within each panel, sort by displayed profile upper-tail mass P(residual height > 100 m), ascending; ties by individual identifier. Sorting is descriptive only and does not define classes.
display_definition.color_scale: Single linear probability scale shared across all five panel heatmaps, from 0 to the observed maximum displayed cell probability.
display_definition.individual_labels: Do not print source individual identifiers on the figure; report n per panel and retain identifiers only in the machine-readable descriptive table.
display_definition.annotations: No PASS/FAIL labels, p-values, clusters, dendrograms, or inferred strategy names.

claim_boundary: The figure visualizes the content of an already-completed inferential audit; it is not a new statistical test.
Differences in displayed profile width, tails, asymmetry, or multimodality are descriptive observations only.
No vertical-niche type or individual strategy class is inferred.
Non-additive and heteroscedastic device error remains unresolved.
